# Pásalo Pa'lante

> A global kindness movement and sister initiative of Te Amo PR, a U.S. 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN 66-0975633) based in Puerto Rico. Our mission is to mobilize 1 billion acts of kindness worldwide during Kindness Season (November 1 – January 31).

Pásalo Pa'lante ("pass it forward") invites individuals, families, schools, nonprofits, companies, municipalities, and ambassadors to do one act of kindness and pass it on. The legal nonprofit behind the movement is Te Amo PR; pasalopalante.com is the dedicated movement platform for public participation, ambassador programs, kindness campaigns, school and community activations, and global storytelling.

- [Share an act](/share): Share an act of kindness you did or received.
- [Wall of Kindness](/wall): Real stories of acts from people around the world.
- [Kindness ideas](/ideas): Simple ideas you can do today.
- [Donate](/donate): Support the movement through Te Amo PR (tax-deductible in the U.S.).
